SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME finprodName,/**金融产品名称**/ ftp.IRS_TYPE ps,/**交易类型**/ to_char(t.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') tradeDate,/**交易日**/ to_char(t.VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') vdate,/**起息日**/ to_char(t.MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') mdate,/**到期日**/ t.PRIN_AMT prin,/**名义本金**/ FCCR_R.Yield*100 yield,/**固定利率%**/ FCPR_R.PAY_CYCLE fixPayCycle,/**固定利率付息频率**/ to_char(FCPR_R.FIRST_PAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') firstPayDateR,/**固定利率首期起息日**/ FRI_F.BENCHMARK_ID intType,/**浮动挂钩利率**/ FRI_F.SPREAD_RATE spreadRate,/**利差（BP）**/ FCPR_F.PAY_CYCLE floatPayCycle,/**浮动利率付息频率**/ to_char(FCPR_F.FIRST_PAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') firstPayDateF,/**浮动利率首期起息日**/ party.counter_name counterId,/**交易对手**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.FINPROD_ID = t.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID left join FIN_RATE_INFO FRI_R on FRI_R.FINPROD_ID = t.FINPROD_ID and FRI_R.INT_TYPE = #{INT_TYPE_01} left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FCCR_R on FRI_R.CASH_ID = FCCR_R.CASH_ID left join FIN_RATE_INFO FRI_F on FRI_F.FINPROD_ID = t.FINPROD_ID and FRI_F.INT_TYPE = #{INT_TYPE_02} and FRI_F.EFF_DATE = ftp.VDATE left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR_F on FRI_F.CASH_ID = FCPR_F.CASH_ID and FCPR_F.EFF_DATE = ftp.VDATE left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR_R on FRI_R.CASH_ID = FCPR_R.CASH_ID and FCPR_R.EFF_DATE = ftp.VDATE left join mst_counter_party party on t.COUNTER_ID=party.counter_id where t.BUSI_TYPE = '13'
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and deal.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{finprodId}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and ftp.IRS_TYPE =#{ps}
order by t.TRADE_ID desc
